text:
jen-support: FYI — PennBridge reported that objects they deleted 2 days ago are still visible in search despite API returning 202. They need an urgent preservation timeline from Legal. ticket# PB-4123 :disappointed:

tara-cust-success: Customer is escalating to their counsel. Asked for exact timestamps and whether a retention override was applied. They want ASAP.

jen-support: Repro steps they gave: curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects?namespace=pennbridge" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prefix":"client_data/2024/"}' -> 202 Accepted. But objects show in search and GET returns 200 with tombstone=false.

mike-sre: Can you paste the full request-id / x-request-id from the delete call? Also which deployment mode — hosted or private?

tara-cust-success: They said private (VPC) and that we migrated them last week to a private control plane.

jen-support: request-id: rq_0a3f9b22, trace: trace-9f2b. Policy id referenced in UI: retention_policy: rp-prod-default-90. Customer insists they had custom 7d policy previously.

owen-engr: Quick hypothesis: during migration the namespace may have been remapped to the default policy. Also check KMS key binding — delete pipeline writes tombstones encrypted with customer-KMS. If key access was revoked during migration, delete worker might have failed to tombstone but API returned 202 due to write-ahead buffering.

lena-legal: From Legal: we need an export of audit logs for the namespace covering 2024-11-01..2024-11-08 and confirmation whether any legal hold flags were applied. Also whether data was available to external search during this window.

mike-sre: Pulled partial logs:
```
2024-11-02T13:02:11Z rq_0a3f9b22 DELETE namespace=pennbridge objects=124 prefix=client_data/2024/ status=ACCEPTED
2024-11-02T13:02:12Z worker-4 tombstone_write namespace=pennbridge object=obj_9f3a err=KMS_ACCESS_DENIED
2024-11-02T13:02:12Z worker-4 tombstone_write namespace=pennbridge object=obj_a81b err=KMS_ACCESS_DENIED
2024-11-02T13:02:12Z delete-queue enqueue namespace=pennbridge batch=1 status=PENDING
```

mike-sre: So tombstone attempts failed due to KMS_ACCESS_DENIED. The delete attempt still enqueued and returned 202. That matches their observation.

own-engr: Repro locally on a staging private control plane: rotate the KMS key used by namespace -> issue delete -> see tombstone error. Repro command snippet we used:
```
# simulate revoked key
export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/revoked
curl -X DELETE "https://staging-api.redwood.local/v1/objects?namespace=test-mig" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prefix":"x/"}'
# check worker logs
journalctl -u delete-worker | tail -n 50
```

jen-support: Customer wants to know whether objects are still retrievable by anyone and whether we can apply an immediate preservation hold (to avoid further accidental deletion).

lena-legal: Preservation hold requested. Please confirm steps and ETA for full audit export. We need chain-of-custody.

mike-sre: Action plan:
- Confirm current KMS key status for pennbridge (mike-sre)
- Backfill tombstone writes for failed objects when key access restored (owen-engr)
- Export audit logs + object listing for 2024-11-01..08 (mike-sre)
- Mark namespace with temporary preserve flag so search hides the objects from public results and prevents auto-purge (jen-support)
- Notify customer and Legal with timeline (tara-cust-success)

owen-engr: If key access cannot be restored quickly we can re-encrypt tombstone payloads with platform backup key under emergency protocol, but that requires approval from Security + customer's key owner. I need a list of object IDs to rebuild tombstones.

jen-support: Customer provided a partial list (attached in ticket): obj_9f3a, obj_a81b, obj_22cc, obj_5dd9. Adding to thread.

audit-bot: Automated note: export job queued export_id=exp_20241108_17 namespace=pennbridge range=2024-11-01..2024-11-08. ETA ~45m.

tara-cust-success: Let me know once preserve flag is set. I told them we could hide hits from search quickly but full legal export will take ~1h.

mike-sre: I've flagged the namespace with preserve=true and blocked auto-purge. Search visibility toggled off for public queries — internal admin searches still show entries for investigation. Logged action: act_98321.

lena-legal: Acknowledged. We'll wait for the export and the KMS remediation plan. Also please capture any changes to retention_policy mapping during the migration window.

owen-engr: I'll start re-encrypt plan only after we get signoff. If KMS access is restored we can replay tombstone writes from delete-queue; if not, we'll escalate to Security for emergency key escrow flow.

jen-support: I'll update the ticket with current steps and ETA. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
